note: Best case today: the 31-block small network with no motion field at 1920x1080. Reference with no motion was 21.8 ms at 1440p (45.9 fps) and 14.5 ms at 1080p (69 fps); the small model measured ~1.14x on the pass. This is the number that says whether 1440p60 is reachable without structural work.
